import hashlib,importlib.machinery,importlib.metadata,json
from pathlib import Path
import cachebox
import cachebox._core
core=Path(cachebox._core.__file__)
assert any(str(core).endswith(s) for s in importlib.machinery.EXTENSION_SUFFIXES)
source=json.loads(importlib.metadata.distribution('cachebox').read_text('direct_url.json'))
assert source['vcs_info']['commit_id']=='10be25afe46afb32c8135db4d1b8e2d94431b9c1',source
Path('/reports/cache-pin.json').write_text(json.dumps({'source':source,'version':cachebox.__version__,'core':str(core),'core_sha256':hashlib.sha256(core.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'python_sources':{str(p.relative_to(core.parent)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(core.parent.rglob('*.py'))}},indent=2)+'\n')
